newsitem.title: UK: GEC eases further as France bans Thomson bid.
newsitem.headline: GEC eases further as France bans Thomson bid.

text.p: Shares in General Electric Co Plc (GEC) eased a further 2-1/2p, showing a total 5p loss on Friday to stand at 381-1/2p by 1119 GMT, after the French government said GEC was not eligible to bid for defence electronics firm Thomson-CSF.
The shares hit a session low of 369p immediately after the news.
"This means there won't be a straightforward successful bid for Thomson and GEC won't gain the hoped-for stronger bias in European defence electronics," said one analyst.
"No one can be particularly surprised about that but at least it seems they've put a marker down," he said.
The French government said it had offers from Lagardere Groupe and a joint bid from Alcatel Alsthom and Dassault Industrie in the Thomson-CSF privatisation.
It said GEC's bid could not be considered as the sale of more than 50 percent of Thomson-CSF to a foreign firm was contrary to national security interests.
